shots.text: Everyone knows Napoleon was tiny. Everyone is *wrong.*
About five foot seven. Average for a Frenchman, maybe *taller.*
His autopsy said five foot two. In *French* inches.
A French inch was longer than a British one. *Nobody checked.*
British cartoonists, led by James Gillray, drew him as a *tantrum-throwing toddler.*
Napoleon: "I am a normal size." Britain: *"Sure you are."*
It didn't help that his elite guards were picked for *height.*
His troops called him "the little corporal." Affectionately. *Nobody checked.*
Some historians still argue over the autopsy's units. Most say *French.*
Two hundred years later, still... *nobody checked.*
